Purple sunsets stretch across the horizon, paints of pinks and oranges bleeding into the blue. Wanderlust defines the free-spirited traveler, ever-seeking novelty, who craves the ephemeral thrill of discovery. Places become mere markers on a map, bridging two disparate realities, erasing borders, but not our own cultural anchors.

Time dissolves when lost in foreign cultures, mythologies, and philosophies. They offer veils for us to hide behind, reminding us of our context, shaping our experiences and bolstering our emotional resolve. We wear their feathers, layering, supplement, and sometimes contradict, creating our own granular identities piecemeal.
